wedding.title: Wedding
wedding.paragraph1: The sacrament of matrimony can be received in St. Martin's Cathedral after meeting the conditions set by canon law.
wedding.paragraph2: The couple must register at the parish office at least 3 months before the planned wedding date. Preparation includes a course for engaged couples and the required documentation.

baptism.title: Baptism
baptism.paragraph1: Baptism is usually administered on Sunday after the 11:00 Mass, or at another time by arrangement with the priest.
baptism.paragraph2: The child's parents register at the parish office and complete a preparation session before the baptism. Godparents must be practicing Catholics who have received the sacrament of confirmation.
baptism.imageAlt: Photo: Baptismal font in the cathedral

lectioDivina.title: Lectio divina
lectioDivina.paragraph1: A shared meditation on Sacred Scripture. Meetings are open to all parishioners regardless of age or experience.

adoration.title: Adoration & the Rosary
adoration.paragraph1: Eucharistic adoration and shared recitation of the Rosary. Come spend time in silence before the Blessed Sacrament.

CookieConsent.infoBody: This website only uses strictly necessary cookies that keep it working (for example, remembering your chosen language). No consent is needed for these.
CookieConsent.consentBody: We use necessary cookies and, with your consent, additional ones that help us improve the website. You can change your choice at any time.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Keep the website working — they remember your language and your cookie choice. They cannot be switched off.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Help us understand which parts of the website visitors use so we can improve them. The data is statistical.

Cookies.title: Cookies
Cookies.intro: A cookie is a small text file that a website stores on your device. Under Section 109(8) of Slovak Act No. 452/2021 Coll. on electronic communications we need your consent to store any cookies other than strictly necessary ones.

table.name: cookie_consent
table.purpose: Stores your cookie choice so we do not ask again.

sections.title: What we use
paragraphs: As of the last update we only use strictly necessary (technical) cookies, which do not require consent. We do not use analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies. Fonts are bundled with the website and are not loaded from external servers.

sections.title: How to change your settings
paragraphs: You can change your choice at any time with the “Cookie settings” button in the page footer. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings.

sections.title: Future changes
paragraphs: If we start using analytics or other optional cookies, we will ask for your consent before using them and update this page.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data we process when operating this website, why we need it and what rights you have. We process data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Slovak Act No. 18/2018 Coll. on personal data protection.
Privacy.operatorName: Parish of St. Martin in Bratislava

sections.title: What data we process and why
paragraphs: The website requires no registration and we do not use advertising or tracking tools.
items: Contact form — name, e-mail address, subject (optional), message text and site language. Purpose: handling your enquiry and replying to it. Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), given by ticking the checkbox before sending. Retention: at most 12 months after the message has been handled.

Technical visit data — IP address, access time and browser type are written to the server’s security logs. Purpose: securing and reliably operating the website and preventing abuse. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Retention: short-term, within the standard logs of the hosting provider.
Cookies — information about them is on a separate page.

sections.title: Who we share data with
paragraphs: We do not sell or publish personal data. Contact form data is accessible to authorised parish staff and to our processors:
items: the e-mail service provider Resend (Resend, Inc., USA) — delivery of form messages; transfers outside the European Economic Area rely on appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision),
the hosting and server infrastructure provider on which the website and its content system run (storage of form messages and server logs).
outro: External services the website links to (for example MainSquare for online orders and tickets) process data under their own responsibility and policies.

sections.title: Your rights
items: object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21),
withdraw your consent at any time — withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing before it.
outro: You can exercise your rights by e-mail or in writing using the controller’s contact details above.

sections.title: Complaint to the supervisory authority
paragraphs: If you believe we process your personal data unlawfully, you can lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic (Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov SR), Hraničná 12, 820 07 Bratislava 27, dataprotection.gov.sk.

sections.title: Security and automated decision-making
paragraphs: We protect data with technical and organisational measures such as an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and restricted access to the content administration. We do not carry out automated decision-making or profiling.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The current version is always published on this page together with the date of the last update.
